title: Physicists use laser light to unlock a crystal's hidden electrical powers
caption:
Physicists discovered that brief bursts of laser light can align tiny electrical pockets inside strontium titanate crystals. The induced order lasts only one picosecond, but it reveals a new path toward controlling quantum materials with optical pulses.

Source: Sciencedaily - Physicists use laser light to unlock a crystal's hidden electrical powers

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261112230500.htm
